description: Primary Assignment Manager view — every audit-head/general task across the firm's active engagements, grouped by status. Filter to a single Engagement to plan one job's fieldwork; filter by Assigned To to see one person's queue. Cards show task_title, audit_head, assigned_to, due_date, and the over_budget flag.
Every open review point across engagements — filter to one engagement during fieldwork/review, or to one assignee to see a preparer's outstanding queries.

Firm-wide compliance triage view — mechanical/standard/independence flags across every engagement, grouped by resolution status. Breach-severity Open flags here are exactly what blocks an engagement's Partner Sign-off transition.
